name: Miami International Autodrome

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap highway=raceway ways (ODbL, Overpass API) forming the 5,412 m Grand Prix loop, Taubin-smoothed; matches the F1 live-timing trace (MultiViewer API) to ~6 m rms
sources.width: Published/approximate: ~15 m pit and back straights, ~13 m typical, ~10.5 m in the slow Turn 14-15 chicane
sources.elevation: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM via EPQS (https://epqs.nationalmap.gov/v1/json), centreline + edge samples
sources.camber: USGS 3DEP 1 m lidar DEM edge-vs-centre samples
sources.pit: OpenStreetMap way "Pit Lane" (1017340352) along the pit straight beside Hard Rock Stadium
sources.corners: Official F1 turn numbering from F1 live-timing circuit data (MultiViewer API circuits/151/2026) fitted to the centreline
sources.trim: Medium-low downforce: three long straights (DRS) offset by the slow Turn 14-15 chicane and stadium esses
sources.pitLimit: F1 Sporting Regulations default 80 km/h (Miami GP event notes)
sources.pitLoss: F1 green-flag pit loss ~19.5 s from F1 live-timing derived circuit data (MultiViewer API)
sources.raceLaps: F1 2026 Miami GP: 57 laps; 2026 sprint weekend (FIA/F1 2026 Sprint calendar), sprint 19 laps

notes: Anticlockwise. Temporary circuit in the Hard Rock Stadium car parks: race markings are not visible on NAIP imagery, so the start/finish line is placed opposite the middle of the pit garages (approximate, ~380 m before the Turn 1 apex). 3DEP is a bare-earth DEM: the short section near the Turnpike ramps follows ground level.
